name: evb-viewer
author: Eugene Barsky <34789976+evb0110@users.noreply.github.com>
description: EVB Viewer — a PDF and DjVu document viewer

scripts.dev:clean: pnpm run clean:cache && nuxt prepare && pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:all: pnpm electron:run stop --session=default && nuxt prepare && pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:quick: pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:fast: pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k "nuxt dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3235" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3235 && electron ."
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.validate:web: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:log: mkdir -p .tmp && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; pnpm run build:desktop 2>&1 | tee .tmp/build.log'
scripts.build:strict: pnpm run build:log && pnpm run build:warnings:check
scripts.build:electron: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/main.js --external:electron --external:electron-updater && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/image/pdf-combine-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/pdf-combine-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/features/documents/main/pdf-conformance-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/pdf-conformance-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/ocr/worker/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/ocr-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/search/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/search-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/features/page-ops/main/crop-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/page-ops-crop-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/features/image-export/main/tiff-combine-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/image-export-tiff-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/features/djvu/main/pdf-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/djvu-pdf-worker.js --external:electron && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs dist-electron/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:electron && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run typecheck:i18n-app
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss,css}" && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix --max-warnings=0 && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss,css}" && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle
scripts.gate:quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:coverage
scripts.validate: pnpm run gate:quality && pnpm run build:strict && pnpm run knip && pnpm run check:architecture
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:e2e:electron
scripts.test:e2e:electron:smoke: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run test:e2e:electron:smoke:no-build
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run release:verify:checks && pnpm run release:verify:package:local && pnpm run check:resources:matrix
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm run check:architecture:dep-graph && pnpm run check:architecture:boundaries
scripts.gate:pre-release: pnpm run validate && pnpm run test:smoke
